# Looply · 首页 Feed 推荐流程图 v1.0 · 2026-06-17 # 研发编码参考数据，从 SVG <metadata> 提取
swimlanes: - key: "A" name: "客户端" - key: "B" name: "首页/Feed服务" - key: "C" name: "推荐服务" - key: "D" name: "商品系统"
sections: - name: "① For You 推荐请求（已登录）" steps: - type: start_end text: "用户打开首页 / 切换 For You Tab / 下拉加载更多" - type: process lane: "A" text: "发起 Feed 请求 (user_key + market_id + channel_id + session_id + page_token)" - type: cross_lane from: "A" to: "B" text: "路由到 Feed 服务" - type: decision lane: "B" text: "user_key 存在?" on_no: "降级至流程②" yes_label: "是" no_label: "否" - type: cross_lane from: "B" to: "C" text: "触发四通路并行召回 (A1 Session兴趣 + A2 24h兴趣 + B New Arrivals + C Best Sellers)" - type: process lane: "C" text: "并行执行（仅查在售 listing）： A1 当前Session兴趣相似召回 A2 24h兴趣相似召回 B New Arrivals 召回 C Best Sellers 召回" - type: cross_lane from: "C" to: "D" text: "按 on_shelf 过滤查询商品库" - type: cross_lane from: "D" to: "C" text: "返回在售候选商品池" - type: cross_lane from: "C" to: "B" text: "返回候选商品池" - type: process lane: "B" text: "候选池合并去重 （排除已展示 listing）" - type: process lane: "B" text: "频控过滤 （24h 曝光上限）" - type: process lane: "B" text: "间隔去重 + 多样性打散" - type: process lane: "B" text: "配额混排 （A1:A2:B:C = 按配置比例）" - type: process lane: "B" text: "组装响应（20条 + next_page_token）" - type: cross_lane from: "B" to: "A" text: "返回 Feed 数据" - type: process lane: "A" text: "渲染商品卡" - type: cross_lane from: "A" to: "B" text: "上报曝光埋点 (listing_id + user_key + market_id)" - type: process lane: "B" text: "写入 feed_exposure 记录" - type: start_end text: "完成" - name: "② 未登录降级流程" steps: - type: start_end text: "用户未登录打开首页 For You Tab" - type: process lane: "A" text: "发起 Feed 请求 (device_key 替代 user_key，无登录态)" - type: cross_lane from: "A" to: "B" text: "路由到 Feed 服务" - type: decision lane: "B" text: "user_key 存在?" on_no: "跳过 A1/A2 通路" yes_label: "是" no_label: "否" - type: process lane: "B" text: "仅执行 B+C 通路 (New Arrivals + Best Sellers，仅查在售 listing)" - type: process lane: "B" text: "混排" - type: cross_lane from: "B" to: "A" text: "返回 20 条 listing" - type: process lane: "A" text: "渲染商品卡（无个性化标记）" - type: start_end text: "完成" - name: "③ A1/A2 召回为空降级" steps: - type: start_end text: "A1/A2 通路召回执行" - type: decision lane: "C" text: "A1 + A2 召回结果为空?" on_no: "正常继续混排" yes_label: "是" no_label: "否" - type: process lane: "C" text: "降级：A1/A2 配额转给 B+C 兜底" - type: cross_lane from: "C" to: "B" text: "通知 Feed 服务降级策略" - type: process lane: "B" text: "按 B:C 比例补足配额" - type: start_end text: "完成（降级为 New Arrivals + Best Sellers 混排）"
svg.text: Looply · 首页 Feed 推荐流程图
用户打开首页 / 切换 For You Tab / 下拉加载更多
发起 Feed 请求 (user_key + market_id + channel_id + session_id + page_token)
触发四通路并行召回 (A1 Session兴趣 + A2 24h兴趣 + B New Arrivals + C Best Sellers)
并行执行（仅查在售 listing）： A1 当前Session兴趣相似召回 A2 24h兴趣相似召回 B New Arrivals 召回 C Best Sellers 召回
按 on_shelf 过滤查询商品库
候选池合并去重 （排除已展示 listing）
频控过滤 （24h 曝光上限）
间隔去重 + 多样性打散
配额混排 （A1:A2:B:C = 按配置比例）
上报曝光埋点 (listing_id + user_key + market_id)
用户未登录打开首页 For You Tab
发起 Feed 请求 (device_key 替代 user_key，无登录态)
仅执行 B+C 通路 (New Arrivals + Best Sellers，仅查在售 listing)
渲染商品卡（无个性化标记）
A1 + A2 召回结果为空?
降级：A1/A2 配额转给 B+C 兜底
通知 Feed 服务降级策略
按 B:C 比例补足配额
完成（降级为 New Arrivals + Best Sellers 混排）
